ALPHABET CENTER · LETTER F

Letter F — Fish.

The letters F f swim in with a teal fish. F is a windy, whispery letter — you can feel it on your lip, which makes it irresistible to children.

Meet the letter, hear its sound, trace it together — then play. Everything on this page is free, gentle and paced for you.

THE LETTER SOUND

What does F say?

“f — fff, a long windy sound”

F says fff — a long, windy sound made with top teeth on the bottom lip. Hold it out: fffff. If it tickles your lip, you are doing it right.

TRACE THE LETTER

Trace F f together.

Follow the numbers with a finger — on screen or on each other’s palms. The arrows show the way to go, the numbers show where to start, and a grown-up reads the little script below each card. Slow and wobbly is exactly right.

Trace the uppercase F

Start at 1 at the top, pull straight down. Lift. Start at 2 at the top, slide straight across. Lift. Pull straight across the middle bar.

Trace the lowercase f

Start at 1 at the top, curve over to the left and pull straight down. Lift. Start at 2 at the left, pull straight across.

TAKE IT OFF SCREEN

Wind and fish.

Two minutes is plenty. Follow your child’s lead and stop while it is still fun — that is the whole method.

  1. 01

    Cup your hands like a fish and swim them through the air while saying fff.

  2. 02

    Blow a tissue up in the air with a long fffff and catch it.

  3. 03

    Finish with five fast fish kisses — pop your lips like a fish five times.

PLAY & PRACTICE

Games that use this letter.

The games mix every letter — play them after meeting two or three letters, or any day your child asks. No scores, no timers, no wrong answers that count.
